caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher centered on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of transparent blue, with the color ranging from light blue highlights to deeper, richer blue and purple tones, particularly at the base and handle. The pitcher features a round, bulbous body that narrows at the neck before flaring out again at the rim. There is a single handle attached to the neck and the upper body of the vessel, curving outward and upward in an elegant loop. The reflection and shading on the pitcher give it a glossy, glass-like appearance, with visible light reflections and translucent effects. The base is circular and relatively wide, supporting the rounded body above it. There is a small, stylized signature visible at the lower left edge of the image, with additional number markings centered along the lower edge. The rest of the composition is uncluttered, focusing solely on the depiction of the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
